seo_title: Seaside Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 3 Free
seo_description: Christmas events for kids in Seaside and Marina, California for 2026: 4 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked against each host.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Seaside for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (the Winter Wonderland and Seaside Tree Lighting at City Hall and the Marina tree lighting) through December 12 (Cereal with Santa at the Oldemeyer Center), with Santa in the Neighborhood in Marina (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Seaside

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Seaside and neighboring Marina
  • 3 free events, including Winter Wonderland and Seaside Tree Lighting at City Hall (December 4)
  • Meet Santa: Santa in the Neighborhood in Marina (December 5) and Cereal with Santa at the Oldemeyer Center (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Seaside Tree Lighting at Winter Wonderland (December 4) and the Marina Christmas Tree Lighting at Vince DiMaggio Park (December 4)
  • Season: December 4 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Seaside families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Salinas, which covers the Tree for Peace lighting, Santa visits and parades nearby.
